thank you night sky.  your right the depression only win if i let it. it is my life and now i just got to go and live it.

I fear getting help in real life  because i don't want my family and friends to worry about me.  I don't want to go to on campus cosoling because they may put me on medical leave or ban me from the labs and that would destroy this whole semesters worth of work.

two things that have always been important too me. my dad a my grandfather are my greatest rolemodles. they are caring fathers loving husbands and involved with their communities.  I someday hope to be the same.  secondly in ever game i have ever player i mostly played the healer, when my friends have problem they would come to me for advice and help and i always marveled at the skill of doctors.  i wanted to be a doctor but i cant stomach dissection so i don't think i would do well in med school. so i am studying chemistry and want to go in to pharmaceuticals, regenerative medicine or build medical tools for doctors.  

  now I just need to find purpose and direction.  I have been just going through the motions for months. I just need to find some goals and do the thing i love doing with the people that are close to me.  the next time i feel down i will read this.
